```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
fmt_eu_pop <- function (val) {
  if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(val)
  if (v <= 0) return("-")
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    m <- round(v / 1000000, 2)
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(m, nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)), "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    k <- round(v / 1000, 1)
    if (k == floor(k)) {
      return(paste0(formatC(as.integer(k), format = "d", big.mark = " "), "k"))
    }
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(k, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(as.integer(round(v))))
}

fmt_eu_coord <- function (x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(x), 2), nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)
  gsub("\\.", ",", s)
}

get_entry_pop <- function (entry, yr_str) {
  p <- entry$population[[yr_str]]
  if (is.null(p)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(p)
}

clean_reg_short <- function (nm) {
  s <- sub("\\s*\\(.*$", "", as.character(nm))
  s <- gsub("Governorates", "Gubs.", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Governorate", "Gub.", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Province of the ", "", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Governor-Generalship", "Gov.-Gen.", s, fixed = TRUE)
  trimws(s)
}

build_region_df <- function (reg_slug) {
  sub_list <- Filter(function (e) identical(as.character(reg48_map[[e$key]]), as.character(reg_slug)), all_entries)
  rows <- lapply(sub_list, function (e) {
    raw_oth <- if (length(e$other_names) > 0) unlist(e$other_names) else character(0)
    if (length(raw_oth) > 1) {
      oth <- paste(head(raw_oth, 2L), collapse = "; ")
    } else if (length(raw_oth) == 1) {
      oth <- raw_oth[1]
    } else {
      oth <- "-"
    }
    coords_span <- paste0(
      fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), ", ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]),
      " (", e$country, ")"
    )
    data.frame(
      `Settlement` = e$name,
      `Historical / Local Names` = oth,
      `Coords & Country` = coords_span,
      `1815AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1815")),
      `1858AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1858")),
      `1897AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1897")),
      `1914AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1914")),
      `1917AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1917")),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

# Overview and 48-Region Gazetteer Methodology

This supplementary gazetteer compiles 265 individual urban, industrial, fortress, and administrative settlements across all 48 period-authentic Governorates (*Guberniyas*), Oblasts, Finnish Provinces, Vistula Provinces, and Habsburg Ukrainian Crownlands of Late Imperial Russia and its western borderlands (excluding Central Asia and the Southern Caucasus) from the Congress of Vienna in 1815AD to the revolutions of 1917AD. Every settlement record is stored in imperial_russia_post_1815_settlements.json in the strict six-key population_Stadester dictionary format (name, other_names, coords, country, key, and population), keyed as Name-Country according to contemporary sovereign country labels (Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, Finland, and Moldova) with georeferenced decimal coordinates and positive integer population series across up to six benchmark dates (1815AD, 1833AD, 1858AD, 1897AD, 1914AD, and 1917AD; tables below display 1815AD, 1858AD, 1897AD, 1914AD, and 1917AD for concise portrait readability while full 1833AD returns remain in the JSON archive).

For each settlement, headcounts are anchored in primary fiscal, statistical, and census enumerations: the Seventh (1815-1816AD), Eighth (1833-1835AD), and Tenth (1857-1858AD) Imperial Soul Revisions and Ministry of Internal Affairs town tables [@Troinitsky1861; @Kabuzan1971; @Rashin1956], the First All-Russian General Census of 28 January 1897AD across all 89 guberniya volumes and the Central Statistical Committee synthesis of settlements exceeding 500 inhabitants [@Troinitsky1905; @Troinitsky1905Goroda], the 1 January 1914AD Central Statistical Committee and Warsaw Statistical Committee pre-war municipal yearbooks [@TsSK1915; @WarsawStat1914], the Finnish decennial statistical censuses of Tilastollinen paatoimisto [@FinlandStat1870_1915], the Austro-Hungarian and Hungarian decennial censuses of 1869-1910AD for Galicia, Bukovina, and Subcarpathia [@OsterreichischeStatistik1912; @MagyarStatisztika1912], and the 1916-1917AD All-Russian Urban and Agricultural Censuses paired with Tatiana Committee wartime refugee records [@AgCensus1917; @Gatrell1999]. In strict compliance with the population_Stadester specification, only inhabited benchmark dates (population > 0) are stored in the JSON dictionary; industrial, coal, rail, and Arctic boomtowns founded after 1815AD (such as Yuzovka in 1869AD, Novonikolaevsk in 1893AD, Bodaibo in 1864AD, Belotsarsk in 1914AD, and Romanov-on-Murman in 1916AD) display "-" prior to their establishment.

```{r fig1-md-only, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!knitr::is_latex_output() && !isTRUE(getOption("intellte.dom_mode", FALSE))) {
  render_figure_template(
    "figures/imperial_russia_post_1815_regional_map.png",
    list(
      caption = "Governorates, oblasts, crownlands, railways, and major urban centres of Late Imperial Russia and Austro-Hungarian Ukraine (1815AD - 1917AD).",
      label = "fig:hero-map",
      span_columns = TRUE
    )
  )
}
```

# Warsaw, Plock & Lomza Governorates

Table \ref{tab:reg1-sites} lists the 6 catalogued settlements in Region 1 (1. Warsaw, Plock & Lomza Governorates (Congress Poland Capital Core: Warsaw 884k in 1914AD)), where total regional population grew from 1 020k in 1815AD to 3 536k at the 1897AD Census and 5 050k in 1914AD (+395,1%), shifting to 4 420k in 1917AD (-12,5% across 1914-1917AD) [@WarsawStat1914; @Troinitsky1905Goroda; @Corrsin1989; @Gatrell1999].

```{r table-reg1, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg1 <- build_region_df("poland_warsaw_plock_lomza")
render_table_template(
  df_reg1,
  list(
    caption = "Urban settlements and benchmark population series in Warsaw, Plock & Lomza Governorates (1815AD - 1917AD).",
    label = "tab:reg1-sites"
  )
)
```

# Regional Urban Sample Summary

Table \ref{tab:regional-summary} aggregates the combined urban population of all 265 catalogued settlements across the 48 period-authentic regions from 1815AD to 1917AD [@Troinitsky1905Goroda; @TsSK1915; @Rashin1956; @AgCensus1917].

```{r table-regional-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
bench_yrs <- c("1815", "1858", "1897", "1914", "1917")
sum_rows <- lapply(seq_along(summary_meta$regions), function (idx) {
  reg <- summary_meta$regions[[idx]]
  rslug <- as.character(reg$id)
  sub_e <- Filter(function (e) identical(as.character(reg48_map[[e$key]]), rslug), all_entries)
  raw_sums <- sapply(bench_yrs, function (y) {
    vals <- sapply(sub_e, function (e) {
      v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
      if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
    })
    sum(vals)
  })
  sums <- sapply(raw_sums, fmt_eu_pop)
  if (raw_sums[["1815"]] <= 0) {
    pct_s <- "Post-1850AD"
  } else {
    pct <- round((raw_sums[["1914"]] - raw_sums[["1815"]]) / raw_sums[["1815"]] * 100, 1)
    pct_s <- paste0(if (pct > 0) "+" else "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "%")
  }
  data.frame(
    `Region (Catalogued Cities)` = paste0(clean_reg_short(reg$name), " (n = ", length(sub_e), ")"),
    `1815AD` = sums[["1815"]],
    `1858AD` = sums[["1858"]],
    `1897AD` = sums[["1897"]],
    `1914AD` = sums[["1914"]],
    `1917AD` = sums[["1917"]],
    `1815-1914AD` = pct_s,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_sum <- do.call(rbind, sum_rows)

tot_raw <- sapply(bench_yrs, function (y) {
  vals <- sapply(all_entries, function (e) {
    v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
    if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
  })
  sum(vals)
})
tot_sums <- sapply(tot_raw, fmt_eu_pop)
tot_pct <- round((tot_raw[["1914"]] - tot_raw[["1815"]]) / tot_raw[["1815"]] * 100, 1)
tot_pct_s <- paste0(if (tot_pct > 0) "+" else "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(tot_pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "%")

tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Region (Catalogued Cities)` = paste0("Total Gazetteer Sample (n = ", length(all_entries), ")"),
  `1815AD` = tot_sums[["1815"]],
  `1858AD` = tot_sums[["1858"]],
  `1897AD` = tot_sums[["1897"]],
  `1914AD` = tot_sums[["1914"]],
  `1917AD` = tot_sums[["1917"]],
  `1815-1914AD` = tot_pct_s,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_sum <- rbind(df_sum, tot_row)

render_table_template(
  df_sum,
  list(
    caption = "Combined Urban Population Across All 265 Gazetteer Settlements by 48 Period-Authentic Regions (1815AD - 1917AD).",
    label = "tab:regional-summary"
  )
)
```
